title: Lifecycle translation integrity
objective: Verify that the MCP adapter correctly translates external phase labels to canonical lifecycle phases, and that transition resolution works after rehydration from disk.

source.description: WP-001-D2: Prevent vocabulary drift between adapter presentation layer and canonical lifecycle states

execution.criteria: project_get_allowed_transitions returns valid transitions for a project whose cursor was loaded from disk (not initialized through project_init)
execution.expected_outcome: Transitions are returned with from/to phase numbers matching the TransitionTable, and no 'Cursor not found' error

pass_criteria.description: Rehydration: get_cursor succeeds for disk-only cursor
evidence_required: project_get_cursor returns cursor with phase field
project_get_allowed_transitions returns transitions array, not error

pass_criteria.description: Phase mapping: adapter phase labels map to valid TransitionTable phases
evidence_required: All returned transition fromPhase values exist in TransitionTable.all

pass_criteria.description: No vocabulary leak: response does not contain non-canonical phase names
evidence_required: Response phase labels are numeric (1-8), not free-text like 'Plan' or 'Agent Work'

translation_map.description: Canonical mapping from adapter phase labels to lifecycle semantics
